<!DOCTYPE html>
<!--
================================================================================
  REPORT: WO Finisher
  PATH:   Manufacturing/WO_Finisher.htm
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Production floor finish tool on the v1.2 "Workspace" chrome. Groups
  in-progress Work Orders under their parent Manufacture Order (pick worst-of
  status, calendar category, live WIP value at part.avgCost, step + MO
  completion %). Each WO row expands to a read-only view of its raw-material
  woitem lines; a per-WO "Finish" button opens the slide-in Finish drawer
  (consume raw materials + receive the finished good with full lot/serial/date
  tracking + scrap), and each MO header carries a staged "Finish MO in order"
  action that finishes producers → consumers, stopping at the first WO that
  isn't buildable.

  The finish + scrap ENGINE lives in the shared fb-mfg script (FBMfg namespace,
  inlined via the fb-mfg Script directive after fb-lib); this report holds only
  the report-side finish/track/scrap DRAWER UI (PSFinish) + the staged finish,
  wired to FBMfg.Finisher / FBMfg.Scrap / FBMfg.Staging.
================================================================================
-->
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <title>WO Finisher - Fishbowl BI</title>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />

  <!-- Moment.js — fb-lib's Common.formatDate uses moment to format
       dates against the install's DateFormatShort (e.g. dd/MM/yyyy
       for AU). Without it the fallback returns YYYY-MM-DD which
       reads wrong for non-US installs. Must load BEFORE fb-lib so
       its formatDate sees `typeof moment === 'function'`. -->
  <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/moment.js/2.29.4/moment.min.js"></script>

  <!-- Shared Fishbowl BI lib — inlined by Fishbowl from the saved "fb-lib"
       script. Source of truth: scripts/fb-lib.js. Must come BEFORE the
       fb-styles directive so the FBLib namespace is defined for any
       inline code below, and before this report's inline script tag
       at the bottom of body. -->
  <script>
    {% Script fb-lib %}
  </script>

  <!-- Shared Fishbowl BI MANUFACTURING logic — inlined by Fishbowl from the
       saved "fb-mfg" script. Source of truth: scripts/fb-mfg.js. Defines the
       FBMfg namespace (Finisher / Scrap / Staging). MUST come AFTER fb-lib
       (it reads FBLib.Common) and BEFORE the fb-styles style + this report's
       inline script. -->
  <script>
    {% Script fb-mfg %}
  </script>

  <!-- Shared chrome: fb-styles. -->
  <style>
    {% Style fb-styles %}
  </style>

  <style>
    html, body { height: 100%; margin: 0; padding: 0;
      font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }
    /* Body reserves bottom space for the fb-lib debug drawer. The drawer
       itself is fixed-bottom; --debug-drawer-h is set by the observer
       in init() and changes as the drawer opens/closes. */
    body {
      padding-bottom: var(--debug-drawer-h, 0px);
      transition: padding-bottom 0.12s ease;
    }
    .wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100vh; }

    /* fb-drawer body grid (matches Core_Dashboard_Template). fb-styles
       supplies the drawer chrome; these classes lay out grouped fields. */
    .fb-grid { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px 22px; align-items: flex-start; }
    .fb-group { flex: 1 1 220px; min-width: 220px; }
    .fb-group-title {
      font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #475569; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
      padding-bottom: 4px; margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .fb-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
    .fb-field label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: #475569; }
    .ds-btn { padding: 7px 13px; font-size: 12px; border-radius: 7px;
      border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; background: #fff; cursor: pointer;
      font-family: inherit; font-weight: 600; color: #334155; }
    .ds-btn:hover { background: #f1f5f9; }
    .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-primary); color: #fff; border-color: var(--color-primary); }
    .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-dark); }
    .ds-btn-admin { background: #fef3c7; border-color: #f59e0b; color: #7c2d12; margin-right: 6px; }
    .ds-lock-badge { background: #fef3c7; color: #92400e; border: 1px solid #f59e0b;
      padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 7px; font-size: 12px; margin-bottom: 14px; }

    /* ── KPI BAR ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    #kpiBar {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr));
      gap: 10px; padding: 10px 16px; background: #f1f5f9;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .kpi {
      background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 8px 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px;
      box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.03);
    }
    .kpi-label { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; color: #64748b; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
    .kpi-value { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: #1e293b; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
    .kpi-sub   { font-size: 10px; color: #94a3b8; font-weight: 500; }
    .kpi.ok    { border-color: #6ee7b7; } .kpi.ok    .kpi-value { color: #047857; }
    .kpi.warn  { border-color: #fcd34d; } .kpi.warn  .kpi-value { color: #b45309; }
    .kpi.late  { border-color: #fca5a5; } .kpi.late  .kpi-value { color: #b91c1c; }
    .kpi.money { border-color: #93c5fd; } .kpi.money .kpi-value { color: #1d4ed8; }

    /* ── FILTER CHIP STRIP ──────────────────────────────────────── */
    #filtersBar {
      background: white; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding: 8px 16px;
      flex-shrink: 0; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 14px; align-items: center;
      position: relative; z-index: 30;
    }
    .fl-label {
      font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #64748b; padding: 4px 8px; background: #f1f5f9; border-radius: 999px; white-space: nowrap;
    }
    #filtersBar input[type=text] {
      padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px; height: 30px;
      font-size: 12px; color: #374151; background: white; font-family: inherit; min-width: 180px;
    }
    .fl-divider { width: 1px; height: 22px; background: #e2e8f0; flex-shrink: 0; }

    /* ── Multi-select trigger (matches WO_Parts_Availability) ── */
    .ms-container { position: relative; }
    .ms-trigger {
      display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: nowrap; gap: 3px;
      border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 3px 8px;
      background: white; height: 30px; min-width: 180px; overflow: hidden;
      cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px;
    }
    .ms-trigger:hover { border-color: #cbd5e1; }
    .ms-tag {
      background: #dbeafe; color: #1d4ed8; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px;
      font-size: 11px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .ms-tag-x { cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold; }
    .ms-placeholder { color: #9ca3af; }
    .ms-dropdown {
      position: absolute; z-index: 500; top: calc(100% + 2px); left: 0;
      min-width: 260px; max-width: 380px; background: white;
      border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 6px;
      box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.13);
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; max-height: 360px;
    }
    .ms-dropdown.hidden { display: none !important; }
    .ms-search { padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f3f4f6; }
    .ms-search input {
      width: 100%; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 4px;
      padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 12px; outline: none; font-family: inherit;
    }
    .ms-actions { padding: 4px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f3f4f6;
      display: flex; gap: 10px; font-size: 11px; }
    .ms-actions span { color: #3b82f6; cursor: pointer; }
    .ms-actions span:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
    .ms-list { overflow-y: auto; flex: 1; }
    .ms-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 5px 10px;
      cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; }
    .ms-item:hover { background: #eff6ff; }
    .ms-empty { padding: 12px; color: #9ca3af; font-size: 12px; text-align: center; }

    /* ── MAIN TABLE ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    #tableScroll {
      flex: 1; min-height: 0; overflow: auto; background: var(--bg-1);
    }
    table.wip {
      width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12.5px; background: white;
    }
    table.wip th {
      background: var(--menu-bg); color: #fff; font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px;
      text-align: left; padding: 8px 10px; white-space: nowrap;
      position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 5;
      text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    }
    table.wip th.nr { text-align: right; }
    /* Clickable sort headers — subtle hover tint, arrow indicator. */
    table.wip th.sortable { cursor: pointer; user-select: none; }
    table.wip th.sortable:hover { background: var(--menu-bg-2); }
    .sort-arrow {
      display: inline-block; min-width: 10px; margin-left: 4px;
      opacity: 0.55; font-size: 9px;
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }
    .sort-arrow.active { opacity: 1; }
    table.wip td { padding: 6px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); vertical-align: middle; }
    table.wip td.nr { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

    /* MO group header row */
    tr.mo-row td { background: var(--tint-blue); font-weight: 600; border-top: 2px solid var(--fb-blue); }
    tr.mo-row:first-child td { border-top: none; }
    tr.mo-row .twisty { display: inline-flex; width: 14px; height: 14px; margin-right: 6px;
      align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; color: var(--c-secondary);
      transition: transform 0.12s; user-select: none; }
    tr.mo-row.expanded .twisty { transform: rotate(90deg); }

    /* WO row */
    tr.wo-row td { background: #fff; }
    tr.wo-row:hover td { background: var(--bg-1); }
    tr.wo-row.collapsed { display: none; }
    tr.wo-row td.indent { padding-left: 28px; }
    tr.wo-row .twisty { display: inline-flex; width: 12px; height: 12px; margin-right: 4px;
      cursor: pointer; color: var(--c-tertiary); transition: transform 0.12s; user-select: none; }
    tr.wo-row.expanded .twisty { transform: rotate(90deg); }

    /* Sub-detail row */
    tr.sub-row td { background: var(--bg-1); padding: 0; }
    tr.sub-row.collapsed { display: none; }
    .sub-detail {
      padding: 10px 12px 12px 56px; border-top: 1px dashed var(--border-strong);
      border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--border-strong); background: var(--bg-1);
    }
    .sub-detail h5 { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--c-secondary);
      text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; font-weight: 700; }
    table.sub {
      width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 11.5px;
      background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden;
    }
    table.sub th {
      background: var(--bg-1); color: var(--c-secondary); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600;
      padding: 5px 8px; text-align: left; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }
    table.sub th.nr { text-align: right; }
    table.sub td { padding: 5px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bg-2); }
    table.sub td.nr { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
    table.sub tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
    .sub-loading { padding: 12px; color: var(--c-tertiary); font-size: 11px; font-style: italic; }

    /* Badges & status pills */
    .badge { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 4px;
      font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; }
    .b-mo-20 { background: #dbeafe; color: #1e40af; }
    .b-mo-50 { background: #fef3c7; color: #92400e; }
    .b-mo-60 { background: #d1fae5; color: #065f46; }
    .b-wo-10 { background: #e5e7eb; color: #374151; }
    .b-wo-30 { background: #dbeafe; color: #1e40af; }
    .b-wo-40 { background: #d1fae5; color: #065f46; }
    .b-pick-10 { background: #e5e7eb; color: #374151; }
    .b-pick-20 { background: #fde68a; color: #92400e; }
    .b-pick-30 { background: #bfdbfe; color: #1e40af; }
    .b-pick-40 { background: #bbf7d0; color: #14532d; }
    .b-late { background: #fee2e2; color: #991b1b; }
    /* Pick column layout — traffic-light dot (availability state)
       followed by one clickable pill per pick (pick number, coloured
       by pick.statusid). flex-align so dot + pills sit on the same
       baseline; .pick-dot has its own tooltip so hovering the dot
       still surfaces the availability breakdown. */
    .pick-summary {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      font-size: 11px; color: #1e293b;
    }
    .pick-dot {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; cursor: help;
      line-height: 1;
    }
    .pick-dot svg { flex-shrink: 0; }
    .pick-pill {
      text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; line-height: 1.4;
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      transition: filter 0.12s;
    }
    .pick-pill:hover { filter: brightness(0.93); text-decoration: underline; }
    /* Calendar category pill — matches the .badge family in
       size/radius/font so the MO/WO row's status and category pills
       sit on the same visual baseline. Background + foreground are
       set inline at render time from calcategory.color. */
    .cal-cat {
      display: inline-block; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 4px;
      font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4;
      white-space: nowrap;
      background: #cbd5e1; color: #1e293b;        /* neutral fallback */
    }

    /* Progress bar */
    .pbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-width: 130px; }
    .pbar-track { flex: 1; height: 6px; background: #e2e8f0; border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; }
    .pbar-fill { height: 100%; background: #2563eb; transition: width 0.2s; }
    .pbar-fill.ok    { background: #10b981; }
    .pbar-fill.warn  { background: #f59e0b; }
    .pbar-fill.empty { background: #cbd5e1; }
    .pbar-text { font-size: 11px; color: #1e293b; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; min-width: 64px; text-align: right; }

    .row-link { color: #2563eb; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; }
    .row-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
    /* Output cell layout — 2-col grid so all qty pills sit in a
       right-hand sub-column, aligned vertically across every output
       line in the same cell. Left col takes any leftover width and
       holds the part# + description; right col hugs the qty pill so
       the "used / target" digits line up on the right edge. */
    .out-lines {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
      column-gap: 10px; row-gap: 2px;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .out-part { line-height: 1.35; min-width: 0; }
    .out-qty {
      justify-self: end;
      padding: 0 5px; border-radius: 4px;
      font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 600;
      color: #334155; background: #f1f5f9;
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    /* Truncated output cell. An MO (or WO) with a long finished-goods
       list used to stack one line per part, making a single table row
       taller than the viewport. Past OUT_PREVIEW parts the cell shows
       "AAA, BBB, CCC… & 27 more"; clicking swaps in the full stacked
       grid. The part-number run itself ellipsis-clips so the "& N more"
       link is never pushed out of the column. */
    .out-cell.collapsed .out-expanded { display: none; }
    .out-cell:not(.collapsed) .out-collapsed { display: none; }
    .out-collapsed { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; }
    .out-summary {
      line-height: 1.35; min-width: 0;
      overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .out-more {
      flex: none; display: inline-block;
      color: #2563eb; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .out-expanded .out-more { margin-top: 3px; }
    .out-more:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
    .muted { color: #94a3b8; }
    .empty { padding: 36px; text-align: center; color: #94a3b8; font-style: italic; }

    /* Spinner overlay */
    #loadOverlay { display: none; position: absolute; inset: 0;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; z-index: 100; color: #475569; font-size: 12px; }
    #loadOverlay.show { display: flex; }
    @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
    .spin { animation: spin 0.8s linear infinite; }

    /* Drawer body code blocks. */
    .fb-drawer-body code { background: #f1f5f9; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 12px; }
    .fb-drawer-body ul { margin: 0 0 4px 18px; padding: 0; }

    /* ==============================================================
       v1.2 WORKSPACE CHROME + toasts. The topbar, .ps-btn, .spill,
       .kpi-tile and table tiers ship in fb-styles; only report-local
       layout + the toast stack live here.
       ============================================================== */
    /* Larger button glyphs. fb-styles §23 sizes .ps-btn.sm svg at 14px,
       which reads too small on this floor tool (the icon-only refresh/CSV/
       help/gear buttons especially). Bump every button icon to 17px and
       give icon-only buttons a comfortably square 32px box so the glyph is
       clearly visible. Local style loads after fb-styles, so this wins. */
    .ps-btn svg, .ps-btn.sm svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; }
    .ps-btn.icon, .ps-btn.icon.sm { width: 32px; padding: 0; }
    /* The row-level "Finish" / "Finish MO in order" buttons carry a glyph too. */
    .row-finish svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; }

    /* Toast stack (self-contained — no external CSS framework). */
    .toast-container { position: fixed; top: 16px; right: 16px; z-index: 10130; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
    .toast { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-left: 4px solid var(--fb-neutral);
      border-radius: var(--r-card); box-shadow: var(--sh2); padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--c-primary); min-width: 220px; max-width: 380px; transition: opacity .25s; }
    .toast.success { border-left-color: var(--fb-success); }
    .toast.error   { border-left-color: var(--fb-negative); }
    .toast.info    { border-left-color: var(--fb-blue); }
    .toast .toast-icon { font-weight: 800; }
    .toast.success .toast-icon { color: var(--fb-success); }
    .toast.error   .toast-icon { color: var(--fb-negative); }
    .toast.info    .toast-icon { color: var(--fb-blue); }
    .toast .toast-msg { font-weight: 500; }

    /* Read-only raw-material table inside the expanded sub-detail row. */
    .sub-empty { padding: 12px 4px; color: var(--c-tertiary); font-size: 12px; font-style: italic; }
    /* table-layout:fixed + fixed numeric-column widths so EVERY work order's
       sub-table renders identical columns — with the default auto layout each
       WO sized its columns to its own content (long part#/description = wide
       Part column), so expanding different WOs shifted everything around.
       Only the numeric columns (2–7) are pinned; the Part column (1) fills the
       remaining width, which is the same for every WO (the sub-detail cell
       spans the full table). */
    .sd-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12px; table-layout: fixed; }
    .sd-table th:nth-child(2), .sd-table td:nth-child(2) { width: 70px; }   /* UOM */
    .sd-table th:nth-child(3), .sd-table td:nth-child(3) { width: 92px; }   /* Pickable / Picked */
    .sd-table th:nth-child(4), .sd-table td:nth-child(4) { width: 78px; }   /* Target */
    .sd-table th:nth-child(5), .sd-table td:nth-child(5) { width: 78px; }   /* Used */
    .sd-table th:nth-child(6), .sd-table td:nth-child(6) { width: 78px; }   /* Scrap */
    .sd-table th:nth-child(7), .sd-table td:nth-child(7) { width: 56px; }   /* % */
    .sd-table th { background: var(--bg-1); color: var(--c-secondary); text-align: left; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em; padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .sd-table td { padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bg-2); vertical-align: top; }
    .sd-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
    .sd-table td.nr, .sd-table th.nr { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
    /* Part column fills the remainder; long part#/desc wrap inside it rather
       than widening the column (they can't, under fixed layout). */
    .sd-part { font-weight: 700; color: var(--c-primary); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
    .sd-desc { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--c-secondary); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

    /* Row Finish actions. */
    .row-finish { margin-left: 8px; }

    /* MO/WO identity cell — the row label sits on the LEFT, its actions
       (Late pill + per-WO Finish button, or the per-MO Finish button) are
       pushed to the RIGHT edge via margin-left:auto so every row's buttons
       line up in one column. The Late pill lives INSIDE the actions group so
       it snaps immediately to the left of the Finish button. */
    .mowo-cell { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; }
    .mowo-main { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
    .mowo-actions { margin-left: auto; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .mowo-actions .row-finish { margin-left: 0; }   /* gap handles spacing now */

    /* ==============================================================
       FINISH / TRACK DRAWERS — ported from Production_Scheduling_v1.2.
       Two slide-in tiers stacked over the list + the finish/serial/FG
       tracking panel styles.
       ============================================================== */
    .scrim { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; background: rgba(16,16,16,.35); opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: .2s; z-index: 10001; }
    .scrim.on { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }
    .detail { position: fixed; top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 100vh; width: 560px; max-width: 94vw; background: #fff; z-index: 10002;
      box-shadow: var(--sh3); transform: translateX(100%); transition: transform .22s cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
    .detail.on { transform: translateX(0); }

    .pf-table td.num, .pf-table th.num { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
    .pf-table input[type="number"] { width: 80px; height: 26px; padding: 2px 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);

    .pf-sr-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 7px 10px; background: #fff;

    .pf-sr-row .pf-sr-count.warn { color: #8A4E10; font-weight: 600; }

    /* Tracking drawer body — searchable checkbox list. */
    .pf-tk-toolbar { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; font-size: 11px; margin-bottom: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .pf-tk-toolbar input[type=text] { flex: 1; min-width: 140px; padding: 5px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--r-btn); font-family: inherit; font-size: 13px; height: 32px; }

    .pf-tk-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 7px 12px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--c-primary); cursor: pointer; line-height: 1.4; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--bg-2); }

    .pf-tk-count.ok { color: #1B7A46; } .pf-tk-count.warn { color: #8A4E10; } .pf-tk-count.fail { color: #A32439; }

    <!-- ================================================================

    <!-- HELP — fb-drawer style -->

      </div>
      <div class="fb-drawer-body">
        <div class="fb-grid">
          <div class="fb-group" style="flex:1 1 320px;">
            <div class="fb-group-title">What you're looking at</div>
            <p style="font-size:12px; color:#334155;">One row per <strong>Manufacture Order</strong> (blue header) and one indented row per <strong>Work Order</strong> beneath it. Click an MO chevron to fold its WOs; click a WO chevron to drill into the raw-material lines being consumed.</p>
            <div class="fb-group-title">Progress %</div>
            <ul style="font-size:12px; color:#334155; padding-left:18px; margin:4px 0;">
              <li><strong>WO row:</strong> step-count from <code>woinstruction</code> — completed steps (qtyFulfilled ≥ qtyReady) ÷ total steps.</li>
              <li><strong>MO row:</strong> qty-weighted average of its WOs by <code>wo.qtyTarget</code>.</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
          <div class="fb-group" style="flex:1 1 320px;">
            <div class="fb-group-title">Pick column</div>
            <p style="font-size:12px; color:#334155;">Aggregate of every pick attached via <code>pickitem.woItemId</code>. Badge shows the worst still-open status; the count is <code>finished/total</code>. "No picks" means none have been generated yet.</p>
            <div class="fb-group-title">WIP value KPI</div>
            <p style="font-size:12px; color:#334155;">Sum of <code>tag.qty × partcost.avgCost</code> for tags bound to in-progress WOs via <code>tag.woItemId</code>. Uses avg cost — close approximation for FIFO/LIFO but not layer-accurate.</p>
          </div>
          <div class="fb-group" style="flex:1 1 320px;">
            <div class="fb-group-title">Open requirements KPI</div>
            <p style="font-size:12px; color:#334155;">Value of raw-material <code>woitem</code> lines (typeId=20) not yet fulfilled, at avg cost — money that still needs to flow into WIP.</p>
            <div class="fb-group-title">Cost column</div>
            <p style="font-size:12px; color:#334155;">Running cost of the WO = parts <strong>staged in WIP</strong> (tag.qty × avgCost) + parts <strong>already consumed</strong> (woitem.qtyUsed × avgCost). For a Fulfilled WO (status 40) the WIP portion settles to 0 and this becomes the actual cost. The MO row sums across its WOs. Hover for the staged vs. consumed split.</p>
            <div class="fb-group-title">MO/WO data model</div>
            <p style="font-size:12px; color:#334155;">The output part is read through <code>moitem(typeid=50, parent)</code> → child <code>moitem(typeid=10)</code> → <code>part</code>. <code>wo.moItemId</code> points at the typeid=50 parent. The MO's "finished good" column shows typeid=10 outputs with <code>stagelevel=1</code> (top of the stage tree).</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

  <!-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
